asset.title: Write-before-parse preserves auditability but cannot recover an un-emitted action
asset.scope: first-action measurement under fixed native envelope and output budget
asset.observed: PACTA-v2.1 passed 636-output replay qualification and completed a fresh non-degenerate shadow gate, then stopped after 49 complete final responses when one status=incomplete response exhausted 900 output tokens before emitting any action key.
asset.institutional_lesson: Write-before-parse makes a failed response auditable but cannot identify a first action that the provider never emitted. First-action measurement qualification must cover output-budget and envelope-ordering availability, not only parser recovery, before scientific execution.
asset.required_lineage_note: PACTA-v2 lost final measurement because the response was not persisted before strict parsing. PACTA-v2.1 repaired only measurement robustness with write-before-parse and deterministic first-action recovery; measurement robustness repair is not mechanism tuning.
precheck: Persist provider response identity, status, model metadata, usage, raw bytes, and prompt/raw hashes before parsing.
Qualify malformed-envelope recovery and negative fail-closed cases.
Also qualify that the action is emitted before the frozen output limit across representative envelope lengths.
If the provider returns incomplete before an action exists, fail closed and do not retry or infer from current_state/next_goal.
does_not_imply: The non-degenerate shadow gate predicts final-policy benefit.
The fixed Shopping substrate should be retried.
asset.reopen_condition: No PACTA-v2.2 on Shopping. A future experiment requires explicit human authorization and an independent carrier with prequalified first-action availability.
